objective: More booked rides (calls and quote requests) from Charleston-area searches at a cost per real lead the owner accepts

channels.rationale: High-intent local searches (airport, wedding, party bus, Kiawah, cruise, black car) drive bookings; Search-only keeps traffic clean.
exclusions: Performance Max until real-lead conversions are clean

actions.description: Fix double counting: 'Call' tag on tel: clicks only; add website call conversion (forwarding number, 60s)
actions.owner: Owner (GTM + Ads UI), guided by Claude
actions.success_measure: Quote and real-call conversions start appearing; no quote counts twice
actions.rollback_or_exit: Re-add the form trigger in GTM (version history)

actions.description: Separate brand keywords into a Brand ad group (mutation draft M1)
actions.success_measure: Brand and non-brand CPA reported separately
actions.rollback_or_exit: Re-enable the original brand keywords and pause the Brand ad group

actions.description: No budget, bid or goal changes while Maximize Conversions learns
actions.success_measure: Status leaves LEARNING; daily spend stable near $60
actions.rollback_or_exit: If spend runs away or leads stop for 5+ days, revert to Maximize Clicks with a $6 ceiling

actions.description: Decide on raising the budget from $60 to $75/day
actions.success_measure: Budget-lost share under 15% with an acceptable CPA on real leads

actions.description: Make tel-click 'Call' secondary once real calls + quotes reach about 15 in 30 days (mutation draft M2)
actions.success_measure: Bidding optimizes to real leads; cost per real lead is stable or falling

actions.description: Improve mobile landing speed (delay the Facebook pixel; remove the GoDaddy injected script)

assumptions: Phone calls are the main way customers book
The owner wants Google Ads only for now
exclusions: Meta, Microsoft and other platforms (not requested)
Permanent deletion of paused campaigns or ad groups

retention.purpose: Owner-facing Google Ads audit history and before/after baseline for re-audits

deletion.method: Remove the run directory from the repository on owner request or after delete_after

incident.reporting_channel: Claude Code session with the owner
